pkgmetadata.longdescription: Horcrux guest tools for Linux guests: the in-VM agent of Horcrux Console. Captures and encodes the guest display inside the guest (FFmpeg kmsgrab or x11grab with VA-API, NVENC or libx264), injects keyboard, mouse and gamepad input through uinput, syncs the clipboard and sizes displays to the viewer. Talks to the Horcrux node over the VM's virtio-serial guest-tools port.

use.flag: Clipboard and display layout in X11 sessions (xclip, xrandr)
